summary: WWLU is a non-commercial educational radio station located in Lincoln University, Pennsylvania. It is owned and operated by Lincoln University. The note records that the station first went on the air in 1970 under the callsign WLIU, and that its current callsign took effect in 2002.
one_line: WWLU is a non-commercial educational radio station in Lincoln University, Pennsylvania, owned and operated by the university.
